rationale: The assistant identified the blocked defrost drain hole on the first turn, gave a sensible clearing method (warm water, cotton bud, no sharp tools) and the customer confirmed the fix, with good prevention advice at the end. Weaknesses: it gave directly contradictory isolation advice in one message ('switch it off and unplug it' then 'keeping the fridge running... is perfectly safe'), which the customer explicitly flagged and the assistant never addressed; the panel heading 'Likely cause: drain hose' mislabelled the actual drain-hole blockage; and the model-number/'suitable replacement' panel pushed toward parts when none were justified, though no specific part was recommended.
